name: @bzzimmy/pi-claude
description: Claude (Anthropic OAuth/subscription) compatibility layer for pi-coding-agent — keeps ALL extension tools usable under the Claude subscription by mapping unknown flat tool names to mcp__pi__ on the wire instead of dropping them.
